definition: Sales reported by Henkel for the stated scope and period
comparability_notes: Do not equate automatically with Mercedes revenue because scope and reporting semantics differ
notes: Source values are commercially rounded.

definition: Nominal change in reported sales versus the corresponding prior-year period
comparability_notes: Company-specific sales bridge definition and scope
notes: Expressed as a percentage change.

definition: Sales growth adjusted for foreign exchange effects and acquisitions/divestments
comparability_notes: Henkel-specific organic definition; do not compare without aligned definitions
notes: Business-area values are reported without numeric price/volume splits.

definition: Company-reported foreign-exchange effect in the sales-development bridge

notes: Report footnote states that relevant foreign-exchange impacts include IAS 29 effects.

definition: Company-reported sales-development effect of acquisitions and divestments
comparability_notes: Transaction perimeter and timing are company-specific
notes: Do not relabel as an independently calculated M&A effect.

definition: Numeric price component presented by management within organic sales growth

notes: Not disclosed numerically below business-unit level.

definition: Numeric volume component presented by management within organic sales growth
comparability_notes: Management attribution is not causal ground truth
notes: Not disclosed numerically below business-unit level.

definition: Revenue reported by Mercedes-Benz for the stated Group or segment scope

notes: Fact sheet includes reconciliation values at Group level.

definition: Earnings before interest and taxes reported for the stated Group or segment scope

notes: Reported endpoint must remain separate from adjusted EBIT.

definition: EBIT after the company-reported adjustment categories shown in the interim report and fact sheet
comparability_notes: Adjustment policy is company-specific and not cross-company comparable by default
notes: Keep adjustment categories and signs with the source period.

definition: Vehicle units reported for the stated segment region or product category

notes: Not causal ground truth.

description: Foreign-exchange component in a management-reported EBIT bridge
